Lower Text: [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with the lowest level.
Upper Text: [Main] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal. If one of your Digimon with [Ravemon] in its name was deleted by this effect, at the end of your opponent's turn, play 1 [Ravemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
